sources.coverage: Route distance, fare and journey-time estimate for every adjacent station pair on the DMRC network, the Airport Express, the Gurugram Rapid Metro and the NMRC Aqua Line, plus DMRC's published interchange allowances.
limitations: Reached through the open REST wrapper at dmrc-rest-api.vercel.app, which fronts DMRC's own planner endpoints; DMRC publishes no documented public API of its own.
DMRC publishes no GTFS feed, so no working timetable is available. Journey times are DMRC's published estimate, computed from distance at a constant line speed, not observed running times.
Phase IV corridors opened in March 2026 are not yet present in this dataset — see the data-gaps section of the audit.

distances.note: Chargeable route distance published by DMRC for each adjacent pair.

timings.note: Derived from official distances at DMRC's own published line speed.

fares.note: DMRC distance slabs effective 2025-08-25; Airport Express station-pair chart.

headways.note: DMRC publishes no headway data, so interchange waiting uses its own allowance instead.

interchanges.note: Total allowance published by DMRC; the split into walking and waiting is Metrorythm's.
